identity.canonicalName: FIDL-21 日常生活灵活性量表（仅目录，原始21题附录待核）
identity.instrumentFamily: Flexibility in Daily Life (Horne et al.)

construct.constructDefinition: 测量日常认知与行为灵活性相关的重复、任务切换、可预测/控制、规律与思想信念。现只从论文正文确认21题五维计数，不拥有完整逐题文本及反向计分键，不可施测、计算或报告个人得分。

population.populationNotes: 原版验证N=295美国成年人，19–78岁。原版并非中国K12或临床诊断测验；无本站简体译稿。

layoutConstraints: 8分钟仅供系统目录的技术估算，不是作者报告的单独测量时间。
21题五因子计数为6/5/4/3/3，具体题号、题文与反向键必须从Appendix S1读取后另行复核。
五级频率1 Never至5 All the time；正向题需反向；高分表示更不灵活。
原2026中国OCD研究重新得到25题三因子，不能冒充Horne原21题五因子。
当前目录无executable，正式施测入口禁止开放。

intendedUses.notes: 仅原版来源检索，不可实际实施。

evidence.population: US healthy adults ages 19–78; no Chinese validation
evidence.studyDesign: English original study: initial 37 items and final 21 items five factors. Full finalized questionnaire is in Appendix S1, not article text.
evidence.citation: Horne K, Chen T, Irish M (2025). British Journal of Clinical Psychology, 64:315–329; online September 22 2024.
evidence.notes: No item-number/factor/reversal map accessible from main paper; translated and clinical validity not inferred.

source.title: Flexibility in Daily Life, original 21-item five-factor scale

limitations: The 21 official item texts, item-to-factor mapping and positive/reverse keys are missing; no real scoring permitted.
Adult English original; no zh-CN translation or norms.
2026 Chinese OCD 25-item revision is not the official Horne 21-item version.
reportPlan.disclaimer: CATALOG_ONLY source candidate. Not a 21-item executable scale or public assessment.
